newsitem.title: INDONESIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bimantara rated a "buy".
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bimantara rated a "buy".

text.p: Indonesian conglomerate Bimantara Citra was rated a "buy" by Kleinwort Benson Securities on Tuesday.
"Our buy recommendation is supported by a conservative NAV (net asset value) valuation of 3,836 rupiah per share," said William Keeling, head of research for Kleinwort Benson in Jakarta.
The share was trading at 2,600 rupiah, down 75, in mid-afternoon trading on Tuesday.

Bimantara, controlled by President Suharto's second son Bambang Trihatmodjo, has a wide range of business interests including television, satellites, automobiles, cellular phones, hotels and property, gas pipelines, chemicals and finance.
"There is strong likelihood of a significant upward move in the company's NAV over the next two years," Keeling said.
The report said political risks associated with the company were exaggerated.
"Instead, investors should focus on its strong portfolio of fast growing businesses," Keeling said.
